scope: Saved MVP Gemini call records only, not a provider invoice or all Google Cloud projects
deduplication: at + stage + engine + model; remove repeated snapshots and aggregate totals; keep request-level usage only

pricingAssumption.mode: Paid Standard, no cache discount, public Nov/Dec 2026 rate

voiceAcceptance.rateNote: 25 audio tokens/s at $10/1M; recovered normalized audio duration only; not provider usage or invoice

limitations: Historical calls may be missing because old temporary job records were lost.
No historical Google project ID, API key identity, request ID, cache-token or detailed thought-token accounting.
TTS responses are not persisted with provider usageMetadata; app stage wrappers are not upstream request counts.
Client timeout or canceled request does not prove no server generation or charge.
Voice test snapshots are cumulative; count final 44 successes once, not once per report.
These project groups are MVP video/diagnostic groups, not Google Cloud billing projects.
Same timestamped event copies in different reports do not create more calls.
